data.description:
## Observed signal
Error sweep window 2026-09-01T11:58:00-07:00..2026-09-02T10:00:00-07:00 (2026-09-01T18:58:00Z..2026-09-02T17:00:00Z) found GitHub Actions jobs failing before tests in the repository-local `.github/actions/setup-uv` action.

Primary main signal: Test Suite (mirror) run 33574990286, workflow_dispatch on `main` at commit 5ff99170b5d0cf97f2f639f117f4b9337622ba33 (`Install uv through local setup action`, rebar-ticket 5caa), failed across setup-dependent matrix legs within seconds.

Representative error from multiple Linux/macOS/Windows legs:

`ParserError: ... line 51 | throw "Checksum mismatch for $asset: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash"`

PowerShell parses `$asset:` as an invalid variable reference in a double-quoted string. The failure appears before lint/tests/audit/mutation can run. The same signature also appears on Dependabot PR/push runs 33575277400, 33575284677, 33575277452, and 33575284612.

## Root-cause direction
The newly repository-local setup action is implemented in PowerShell and interpolates `$asset:` directly inside a double-quoted string. It should delimit the variable, e.g. `${asset}:`, or otherwise avoid the colon-adjacent variable parse. Because the action is used by the suite, prompt eval, mutation, lint/typecheck, and audit jobs, the parse error is a gate-wide setup failure.

## Acceptance criteria
- `.github/actions/setup-uv` no longer emits a PowerShell parser error for the checksum-mismatch branch on Linux, macOS, or Windows runners.
- A Test Suite (mirror) run on main reaches the intended lint/test/audit/mutation commands instead of failing inside setup-uv action parsing.
- Prompt Eval jobs that use the same setup action also pass setup or fail only in their intended evaluation command, not action parsing.
- Add or update coverage/static validation so `$name:` interpolation in PowerShell action scripts is caught before CI.
data.title: [ci] Local setup-uv action PowerShell parser error breaks every job before tests
